description: Colony Textile Mills Limited is a Pakistani textile manufacturer whose principal activity is the manufacturing and sale of yarns, fabrics and garments, along with trading in real estate. The business traces its origins to 1946, when the principal Colony Textile Mills company was established; the present entity was incorporated on 12 January 2011 and acquired Colony Mills Limited and Colony Industries (Private) Limited in 2014. It runs a spinning division at Ismailabad, Multan and a weaving division on the Manga–Raiwind Road near Lahore, where Toyota and Picanol air-jet looms give it an installed weaving capacity of 122 million square metres a year.
